speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
text: asked	the Minister for Communications and Information (a) for the past five years, how many instances of Internet disruption lasting more than three hours have there been; (b) of these, many cases have been due to cable cuts; (c) how many users have been affected by the latest cable-cut incident in Jurong on 12 April 2017; (d) what are the lessons learnt from the latest cable-cut incident; and (e) what are the measures that IMDA have taken to prevent a repeat.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Thus, it would be premature to share any conclusions or lessons learnt at this time.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: These contractors were also not careful and failed to exercise due diligence when undertaking earthworks.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: So, to overcome these problems, IMDA has been carrying out regular dialogue sessions with relevant Government agencies and their contractors on preventive measures.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: These costs exclude those incurred by consumers and businesses.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: Would the Minister consider asking the companies that caused the cable cut to also compensate the Internet users who are affected by these kinds of incidents?

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: Keep it very short; we are running out of time.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Does the Minister have any data on how well Singapore is doing compared to other developed countries in terms of frequency and extent of Internet disruption?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: And if there is no metric that is currently being tracked, would the Minister consider tracking and publishing that in future?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: I am not too sure whether there is such a global metric.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: But by all accounts, in terms of connectivity, we are doing quite alright.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: In terms of availability, that is something we have to look at.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: At this point in time, there is a demand for faster and better connectivity for the Internet.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: I will take the Member's point and see what we can do.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), provided that Members had not asked for questions standing in their names to be postponed to a later Sitting day or withdrawn, written answers to questions not reached by the end of Question Time are reproduced in the Appendix.]
